name: Phantom
descr: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.

data.motivesAndTactics: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings

features.name: Incorporeal
features.text: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Fear Aura
features.text: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

features.name: Lingering Haunt
features.text: _Countdown (1d6)._ When the Phantom is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom's HP and immediately spotlight them.
